Level 3 - Intermediate 40 min OOP Microsoft Amazon

Polymorphism & vtables: Compile-Time vs Runtime

After this page you can explain the two kinds of polymorphism, say exactly when Java or C++ picks a method (compile time or run time), draw the vptr and vtable for a class on a whiteboard, explain why base classes need virtual destructors, and see how the visitor's double dispatch works. You already know the machinery: it is an ops table of function pointers.
